title: L3-S3: cdcp_core GradeReport + canonical_json + digest
description:
## Goal
Implement the byte-exact substrate from ORACLE-GAUNTLET.

## Types
- ChoiceLetter: A|B|C|D
- ItemResult { item_id, chosen, correct, is_correct }
- GradeReport { schema_version=1, bank_hash, exam_id, seed, item_results, score_correct, score_total, by_module sorted, weak_modules sorted, passed_study_signal }
- ExamAttempt { exam_id, seed, bank_hash, answers: Vec<Option<ChoiceLetter>> } or parallel item_ids + answers

## Functions
- canonical_json(value) -> Vec<u8>
- sha256_hex(bytes) -> String
- digest_report(report) -> String

## Tests
- key_order_stability: same logical object different construction → same digest
- floor_zero: grade report digest twice identical
- integers only for scores

## Acceptance
cargo test -p cdcp_core green; digests match between two encodes.
close_reason: GradeReport + canonical_json + digest_report; unit tests floor_zero + key order

title: L3-S1: Resolve OQ-02 canonical JSON + OQ-03 bank_hash SHA-256
description:
## Goal
Freeze hash/canonical law so GradeExact has zero ambiguity.

## Decisions (implement + document)
- OQ-02: Canonical JSON = UTF-8, sorted object keys at every nesting level, no insignificant whitespace, no floats in GradeReport, LF if newlines. Prefer BTreeMap for maps or serde with sorted keys helper. Document in docs/CANONICAL.md.
- OQ-03: bank_hash = hex(SHA-256( b\"cdcp-bank-v1\\0\" || concat over items sorted by id of canonical item bytes )). Document in content.lock schema.

## Files
- docs/OQ_REGISTER.md (OPEN→VERIFIED)
- docs/CANONICAL.md (new)
- knowledge/content.lock.schema.md or content.lock.example

## Acceptance
1. OQ_REGISTER shows OQ-02 and OQ-03 as VERIFIED with code/doc pointers.
2. Unit test later in S3 proves two HashMap insertion orders yield same digest for same logical report.
3. No open OQ blocks L3 grade.

## Non-goals
Implement full grade() (S5).
close_reason: OQ-02/03 VERIFIED: CANONICAL.md + content.lock.example + cdcp_core/cdcp_bank impl

title: L3-S5: cdcp_grade pure grade() + study signal 27
description:
## Goal
Pure grade(bank, attempt) -> GradeReport implementing GradeExact.

## Behavior
- Match answers to items by item_id order in attempt
- Invalid choice / missing item -> Err (not silent zero)
- score_correct / score_total integers
- passed_study_signal = score_correct >= 27 (from exam_form; const or load exam_form.toml)
- weak_modules: modules with correctness rate < 0.6, sorted ascending module number
- by_module: sorted by module
- grade twice same inputs -> same digest
- Embed bank_hash from bank into report; reject if attempt.bank_hash mismatches

## Tests
- all correct -> 40/40 pass signal true
- all wrong -> 0/40 pass false
- mixed
- bank_hash mismatch error
- MR-IDEM double grade

## Acceptance
cargo test -p cdcp_grade green
close_reason: pure grade(); study signal 27; weak_modules; bank_hash mismatch Err; idempotent digest
